attrs.discharge: NOT discharged, and known to be optimistic. Kohli 2026 measured a nine-judge frontier panel at roughly two effective votes on its own tasks, which is the correlated-error regime this model excludes by construction.
attrs.note: Typing this as `distribution` rather than folding it into the measurement is what makes the gap visible: the Monte Carlo is sound about its model and the model is the part that is wrong.
attrs.statement: Judge errors are independent flips at a fixed rate.
